name: agent
description: The agent's mods: what used to be a rule in CLAUDE.md or a script on a timer now runs inside Claude Code

plugins.name: agent
plugins.description: The bundle with all of the agent's mods. Installing this plugin installs each mod as a dependency

plugins.name: usage-limit
plugins.description: Guards the account usage limit: one subagent at a time above 90%, a pause with a reserve at 98%, and an automatic resume when the window resets

plugins.name: memory-guard
plugins.description: Keeps typecheck, build, test and Playwright below the memory high mark: runs them with a single process, waits or refuses, and retries a command that died with exit 137

plugins.name: skill-loader
plugins.description: Loads the right skill at the right time: typescript-best-practices when reading .ts, writing-for-agents on SKILL.md, AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md, domain-modeling on CONTEXT.md and ADRs, technical-writing on README, commits and PRs

plugins.name: audit
plugins.description: Records every MCP call that writes in one file per day, without refusing anything. /audit shows the last ones

plugins.name: loop-breaker
plugins.description: Notices when the agent goes in circles and tells it to stop and change approach. Refuses nothing

plugins.name: secret-guard
plugins.description: Replaces every secret value in tool output with <hidden:NAME> before the agent reads it, and puts the real value back when the agent writes the placeholder into a secret file

plugins.name: pipefail
plugins.description: Puts set -o pipefail in front of a command that pipes a test runner into tail, head or grep, so a failing test does not exit 0

plugins.name: mod-report
plugins.description: /mods [days] reports, per mod, how often it acted, what it did, and what it cost per tool call, and flags the mods that get in the way

plugins.name: rating
plugins.description: Records every agent turn as a dataset with your 1-5 ratings and automatic weak labels, for analysis and fine-tuning. /rate, /ratings and a rating band above the prompt

plugins.name: global-memory
plugins.description: A VPS-wide memory folder next to the per-project auto memory: rewrites the memory section for both folders and loads the global MEMORY.md. On Team and Enterprise plans it must be an organization mod (prependPlugins in managed settings)

plugins.name: wtf
plugins.description: /wtf has Haiku read a short digest of this session and explain in a few plain lines where it is and what it needs from you, without interrupting the agent
